audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The low-rank SDP uses the wrong spectral scale and admits an unsafe point; The printed infinite-horizon demonstration prior has only the origin robustly safe; Changing disturbance bounds can make the exact conditioned safe set nonconvex
limitations: F1 — The low-rank SDP uses the wrong spectral scale and admits an unsafe point — Counterevidence: Sparse and permutation formulations independently checked positively; the rank cap does not improve this particular rank-one support objective.

F2 — The printed infinite-horizon demonstration prior has only the origin robustly safe — Counterevidence: Theorems18/29 assume stability and are not refuted by an input violating that premise. The distinct Section5.5.2 Frobenius-ball prior is individually stable by independent determinant/trace bounds; its experimental costs were not rerun.

F3 — Changing disturbance bounds can make the exact conditioned safe set nonconvex — Counterevidence: The additive plus sign before the future disturbance was verified at original image detail; no missing-sign finding. In a valid noiseless robust history, sampled points remain in the Theorem26 program.
F4 — A common affine translation can destroy the offline basis — Counterevidence: No failure of the online independence argument or of any specific reported fixed-epsilon experiment is established.

F5 — Horizon monotonicity needs a fixed prediction target — Counterevidence: Under Definitions4/39 a safe longer trajectory can be decomposed into shorter observations without changing the identification target; that interpretation survives.
F6 — The entrywise maximum is not preserved by Schur conjugation — Counterevidence: The conditional existence theorem is not disproved; a complete repair preserving its conclusion is supplied.
F7 — Two positive-radius arguments invert the Schur-complement factor — Counterevidence: Both full-dimensionality conclusions survive the corrected radius.

F8 — Optimization selections require explicit existence and empty-set handling — Counterevidence: The information/span impossibility theorem and generic algebraic rank argument remain supported when the selections are well-defined.
Unresolved limits: Actual author execution behind the printed example was not recovered.

 \qquad S_k^T=\bigcap_{f\in U_k}S^T(f),\] where \(U_k\) consists of dynamics consistent with the collected trajectories. The uncertainty decreases with observations, so \(S_k^T\) increases for a fixed \(T\). The general prediction objective on page 3 is evaluated over the true \(S^T(f_\star)\).
